description: This file contains data structures, constants, and functions related to message export jobs in Mattermost, including job state management, channel metadata, user activity, and file handling.

classes.name: JobData
classes.description: Represents the current state of a message export job, including metadata, progress, and batch information.

classes.name: JobDataExported
classes.description: Contains exported fields of JobData for serialization and transfer.

classes.name: MetadataChannel
classes.description: Holds metadata about a channel, including IDs, names, type, message and attachment counts, and activity period.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Aggregates metadata for multiple channels, including total message and attachment counts and time range.

classes.name: ChannelMemberJoin
classes.description: Represents a user joining a channel, including user info and join time.

classes.name: ChannelMemberLeave
classes.description: Represents a user leaving a channel, including user info and leave time.

classes.name: ChannelMember
classes.description: Basic user info within a channel context.

classes.name: MessageExportCursor
classes.description: Tracks the position within message export pagination.

methods.name: JobDataToStringMap
methods.description: Converts JobData to a map of string key-value pairs for serialization.

methods.name: StringMapToJobDataWithZeroValues
methods.description: Parses a map of strings into JobData, handling default values and conversions.

methods.name: GetInitialExportPeriodData
methods.description: Calculates and caches channel memberships, metadata, and total post count for export start.

methods.name: CalculateChannelExports
methods.description: Returns metadata and user activity histories for channels with activity during a period.

methods.name: ChannelHasActivity
methods.description: Checks if a channel had user activity between start and end times.

methods.name: GetJoinsAndLeavesForChannel
methods.description: Determines user join and leave events within a channel during a period.

methods.name: GetPostAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves file attachments for a post.

methods.name: ChannelTypeDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a string label for a channel type.

methods.name: GetBatchPath
methods.description: Generates a file path for a batch zip archive.

methods.name: GetExportBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend for exporting data, based on configuration.

methods.name: GetFileAttachmentBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend for message attachments.

methods.name: IsDeletedMsg
methods.description: Determines if a message post is marked as deleted based on its properties.
